name: Rigger's Cutting Knife
description: A hooked blade worn smooth by a lifetime of cutting hemp.
benefit: Cuts rope, nets and bindings in a single stroke, and is quick to draw.
cost: Dull against armour; the hook snags and costs a beat on a clean strike.

name: Tithe Collector's Sickle
description: Hung at the hip of the men who gathered the harvest share.
benefit: Strikes against the unarmoured land a little harder.
cost: Settlements that know the shape of it treat the bearer as a collector.

name: Brine-Cured Harpoon
description: A fishing iron stained white where the sea has worked into the shaft.
benefit: Thrown or thrust, it pins a foe in place for a moment.
cost: Salt rots the binding, so repairs come due often.

name: Pyre-Tender's Poker
description: A long iron rod, blackened to the grip from tending the unburied.
benefit: Reaches a little further and burns against the restless dead.
cost: Smells of old smoke, and the living notice it first.

name: Light Axe of the Eastern Riders
description: A short crescent blade, balanced to be swung from a saddle.
benefit: Swings are fast and recover quickly.
cost: Light in the haft, so a heavy foe can turn the blow aside.

name: Oath-Stake Spear
description: A boundary post sharpened and put to a harder use.
benefit: Wounds from it do not close until the wounded foe has eaten.
cost: The bearer owes a favour to anyone they strike down with it.

name: Dagger of the Quiet Shrine
description: Its sheath is lined with felt, so it makes no sound in or out.
benefit: Attacks from hiding are silent.
cost: The wielder cannot speak a word while it is drawn.

name: Flood Widow's Gaff
description: A boat hook bound in black cloth for a drowned husband.
benefit: Hauls a foe or a floating crate a short distance toward the wielder.
cost: Slick in a wet hand, and drops from a tired grip.

name: Dented Bowl Shield
description: Beaten from a temple bowl and hammered back when it buckled.
benefit: Blocks a heavy blow without staggering the bearer.
cost: Weighs on the arm and slows every step.

name: Marsh Reed Buckler
description: Woven reed over a hide skin, light enough to forget.
benefit: Turns arrows and thrown stones with ease.
cost: Splits to the first real blade and has to be replaced.

name: Votive Shield of the Pilgrim Road
description: A shield hung in a shrine and taken down in a hurry.
benefit: Allies standing close behind it take less from ranged fire.
cost: The bearer may not strike first against a pilgrim or a herald.

name: Seer's Glass Lenses
description: Two discs of clouded crystal on a leather strap.
benefit: Reveals faint marks and hidden handholds close at hand.
cost: The world beyond arm's length blurs.

name: Miner's Lamp Cap
description: Felt, with a clay lamp pinned to the brow.
benefit: Lights a short radius in dark places without a free hand.
cost: The flame can be seen from a long way off.

name: Veil of the Pythia's Handmaid
description: A grey linen veil that smells faintly of laurel smoke.
benefit: Steadies the nerves of the wearer near sacred sites.
cost: Strangers will not meet the wearer's eye or trade with them.

name: Scout's Bronze Cap
description: Open at the face so the scout can hear what comes.
benefit: Shrugs off a glancing blow to the head.
cost: Rings loudly when struck and carries the sound.

name: Quilted Garrison Tunic
description: Layers of linen glued and stitched, more patched than whole.
benefit: Absorbs cuts and slashes from edged weapons.
cost: Hot to wear, and costs stamina to run in.

name: Fisherman's Oilskin
description: Stiff with grease, it sheds the spray of a hard crossing.
benefit: Keeps the wearer dry and warm on open water.
cost: Reeks of fish and draws every scavenger on the shore.

name: Mourner's Ash-Grey Robe
description: Worn to the funeral and not washed since.
benefit: The unquiet dead ignore the wearer unless provoked.
cost: The living read the cloth as a curse and keep their distance.

name: Initiate's White Tunic
description: Plain linen taken from a basket at the gate of the rite.
benefit: Resists the shock of cold water and sudden fright.
cost: Carries a mark that a priest will recognise as unsworn.

name: Ore-Scale Vest
description: Thin plates of refined stone sewn onto a hide backing.
benefit: Sheds blows with the density of a bronze cuirass.
cost: Draws charge from the wearer's reserve while it stays on, and the plates are heavy.

name: Shepherd's Fleece-Lined Boots
description: Pegged soles and a cuff of boiled fleece.
benefit: Walks long distances over hills without tiring.
cost: Slippery on wet stone.

name: Ferryman's Deck Shoes
description: Soft soles that grip a wet deck.
benefit: Never slips on a plank, boat or flooded stair.
cost: Fall apart in the dry within a few days.

name: Rider's Leather Greaves
description: Cut for a stirrup, awkward on foot.
benefit: Guards the shins against low blows.
cost: Chafes the wearer, who tires faster.

name: Potter's Heat-Mitts
description: Thick clay-smeared pads sewn onto a leather glove.
benefit: Handles hot metal, kiln-fired goods and heated iron without harm.
cost: Too clumsy to hold a weapon with fine grip.

name: Scribe's Inked Gloves
description: Fingerless, stained blue to the wrist.
benefit: Copies a page or a cipher faster than any bare hand.
cost: The ink marks every door handle, and every guard can follow it.

name: Notched Tally Stick
description: A split stick; the other half is in someone else's keeping.
benefit: Warns the wearer when a creditor draws near.
cost: Whoever holds the other half knows where the stick is.

name: Amulet of the Grain Mother
description: A bundle of barley tied in red wool.
benefit: Food keeps longer in the wearer's pack.
cost: Priests of the grain cult treat the wearer as a thief of their blessing.

name: Folded Lead Curse Tablet
description: Scratched with a name and driven through with a nail.
benefit: Weakens the next foe who wrongs the bearer.
cost: The name on it will learn who carries it.

name: Pilgrim's Shell Token
description: A scallop shell stamped with the seal of a minor shrine.
benefit: Pilgrim roads and shrines treat the bearer kindly.
cost: Raiders know the token too and mark its wearer.

name: Ferryman's Blank Obol
description: A coin with no face, only a hole for the string.
benefit: Fends off a single killing blow, once, then crumbles.
cost: Cannot be spent anywhere in the living world.

name: Hunter's Bone Whistle
description: Carved from a stag's shin, pitched too high for the ear.
benefit: Calms or calls the beasts of the hills.
cost: The pitch carries a long way and wakes the wrong things.

name: Bronze Signal Mirror
description: A polished disc with a sight cut through the middle.
benefit: Flashes across a valley and marks a place for allies.
cost: Anyone with eyes can follow the flash back to the sender.

name: Surveyor's Measuring Chain
description: Twenty links of bronze, each exactly a hand long.
benefit: Measures distances and slopes without error.
cost: Rattles in the pack and rings on any stone.

name: Salvager's Prybar
description: Half a ship's keel-iron on a crooked handle.
benefit: Pries open stuck doors, sunken hatches and warped crates.
cost: A bar that bends is a bar that is gone; repairs are costly.

name: Wax Tablet Case
description: A hinged wooden box of fresh wax, with a bone stylus.
benefit: Takes a rubbing of an inscription for later study.
cost: Each rubbing takes a long while, and wax melts in the heat.

name: Charcoal and Chalk Satchel
description: A canvas bag of sticks, chalk and a lump of tallow.
benefit: Marks a trail through a maze and finds the way back.
cost: The marks are readable to every pursuer too.
